notes.title: An announcement on The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy- Patch 1.1.0.
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you for supporting The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy-.[/p][p]The following patch has been released.
[/p][p]■Platform/version[/p][p]・Steam 1.1.0[/p][p]・The patch’s release date for the Nintendo Switch version will be announced at a later date.[/p][p][/p][p]■Improvements[/p][p]●Chapter Select[/p][p]・Players can now start the game immediately before each decision making scene.[/p][p]・The maximum display area of the Chapter Select menu has been expanded.[/p][p]●Battle[/p][p]・A new Battle Mode “Extreme & Despair” has been added.[/p][p]・The auto-healing in Safety mode has been updated to occur at the end of the player's turn.[/p][p]・Battles that have been cleared before can now be skipped even if they are not similar to any other battles.[/p][p]・“Redo Wave” has been updated to skip any events at the beginning of a wave.[/p][p]●Field[/p][p]・Added UI to show which direction characters are in hallways.[/p][p]・The brightness of the flash from the monitor during the morning and nighttime chime scenes has been decreased.[/p][p]●Gift-O-Matic[/p][p]・The player is now able to go back after selecting a gift to create. Gift creation will only occur after the player has selected the recipient.[/p][p]・The player can now filter gifts by hitting the “Name” button to open the Report Card and checking a character’s Preferred Items.[/p][p]・Grades that will improve by spending time with someone or giving them a gift can now be confirmed on the Report Card menu.[/p][p]●Exploration[/p][p]・Some story-related Exploration sequences can now be skipped.[/p][p]・Random battles will no longer occur based on player selections made during Exploration.[/p][p]●Others[/p][p]・Added a feature to toggle on/off the message window and controls during dialogue screens.[/p][p]・The cursor position will now be retained when saving and loading the game.[/p][p][/p][p]■Battle Balance Adjustments[/p][p]▼Tsubasa Kawana[/p][p]・Decelerate: Area of effect has been expanded.[/p][p]▼Kurara Oosuzuki[/p][p]・Craft Mounted Turret: Increased turrets’ ATK by 1.[/p][p]・Craft Support Tower: Effect range of towers has been expanded.[/p][p]▼Ima Tsukumo[/p][p]・Twin Wing Gale: Added an effect to heal Fatigue.[/p][p]・Bloody Angel’s Fist: Attack area has been expanded.[/p][p]▼Kako Tsukumo[/p][p]・Energy Sniper: “Inflicts Attack -3 on user” has been changed to “Inflicts Attack -2 on user.”[/p][p]・Spirit Rain: “Inflicts Attack -3 on user” has been changed to “Inflicts Attack -2 on user.”[/p][p]▼Moko Mojiro[/p][p]・Moko Dynamite: Armor +1 effect has been added.[/p][p]・Ultra Moko Bomber: ATK area has been expanded.[/p][p]▼Battle Stages[/p][p]・The game balance for some battles has been adjusted.[/p][p]・Some boss behaviors and their skill effects have been adjusted.[/p][p][/p][p]■Bug Fixes[/p][p]●All versions[/p][p]・Fixed an issue where the game crashes when selecting “Chapter09_A_aba_099” and “Chapter09_A_abb_099” in Chapter Select.[/p][p]・Fixed an issue where unique battles can be skipped even though players have not cleared any similar battles.[/p][p]・Fixed an issue where saving/loading during an exploration changes the player’s moving direction and square colors.[/p][p]・Fixed an issue where audio volume cannot be adjusted.[/p][p]・Fixed an issue where visual effects do not show up properly during battle.[/p][p]・Other minor bug and text fixes.[/p][p]●Steam[/p][p]・Fixed an issue where the cursor keeps moving when using the touchpad with no mouse connected.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy-.[/p]

notes.title: [ver1.0.6] Update Notice 2025/5/30
notes.notes:
Thank you for always enjoying this game.
The following bugs have been fixed.

Patch Ver.1.0.6

■Improvements:

・For certain routes, allow skipping similar battles after clearing them once.
・Enable skipping the screen effects of morning and evening chimes.
・Reduce the button press time required to skip movies.
・Enhance the battle experience for "Chapter00_1-100".

■Bug Fixes: 
・Fixed an issue where the battle does not end even after defeating a boss that needs to be defeated simultaneously with three units in the same turn.
・Fixed an issue where simplified exploration might not be possible.
・Fixed an issue where progression might become impossible in "Chapter00_0_a_036".
・Fixed an issue where progression might become impossible in battles with subtitle voice playback.
・Fixed an issue where the game might freeze during chapter selection in certain environments.
・Other minor bug fixes and typo corrections.
・Fixed an issue where the game might force close on the loading screen before the title when starting the game. 
Note: If the save data is corrupted due to actions like "turning off the power while saving", the changes in options and the gallery save state will be reset.

We hope you will continue to enjoy "The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy-".

notes.title: [Update] Regarding viewing the Steam version bonus novel
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued patronage of our games.
The issue with the Steam version bonus novel for "The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy-" that could not be viewed has been resolved, and those who currently own the content can now view it.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.
You may need to reinstall the bonus novel on some Steam versions, so please check the details below.

[Details of the support]
[b]Target title[/b]: Steam version pre-order bonus novel The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy- Novel Former Lives of the SDU: File 03 - Hiruko Shizuhara's First Battle'"

[b]Support content[/b]: The target title will now be displayed in the launch options when the main game is launched. Select the content you want to launch and play.

[b]Note:[/b] If the target title is still not displayed in the launch options, please try the following.
　　-Open the main game "The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy-" in your Steam library.
　　-Select Properties > DLC from the Management (gear icon) on the right side of the screen.
　　-Uncheck "Install" for the title in question, then check it again and it will be reinstalled and will appear in the launch options.

We appreciate your continued patronage of "The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy-".

notes.title: Regarding viewing the Steam version bonus novel
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued patronage of our games.
It has been confirmed that the bonus novel for "The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy-" is currently unavailable.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause to customers who have been looking forward to the game.
We are currently investigating and verifying the cause of the problem in order to resolve the issue as soon as possible.

[Bug details]
- Target: Steam version pre-order bonus novel The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy- Novel Former Lives of the SDU: File 03 - Hiruko Shizuhara's First Battle'"

- Content: The above DLC cannot be launched after installation


We will report on the above bug as soon as there is any progress.
We appreciate your continued patronage of "The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy-".

notes.title: Important Notice for PC Players regarding the Demo Version
notes.notes:
Thank you very much to everyone playing the Steam demo.
We have confirmed that some users are experiencing game crashes when using certain security software.

We are urgently working to ensure that the game does not crash in these environments. We will inform you once the issue is resolved.

Additionally, crashes may occur due to the state of the play environment or if it does not meet the system requirements of the game.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.
